title: Build initial molecular geometries
action: Construct initial 3D Cartesian coordinates for compounds 5–11, the diene product 23, and H2 molecule using a molecular builder or manual assembly based on the chemical structures described in the paper.
description: Generate initial molecular geometries for all required species.

title: B3LYP optimization and butterfly bending angles for all compounds
action: Optimize geometries of compounds 5–11 at B3LYP/6-31G(d) level. For each compound, compute the butterfly bending angle Ψ for the C2=C5 double bond as Ψ = 180 − |D|, where D is the dihedral angle 1-2-3-4. Report the angles in a JSON file.
description: Butterfly bending angles (Ψ) in degrees for compounds 5–11 at B3LYP/6-31G(d).
output_schema: A JSON object with keys '5', '6', '7', '8', '9', '10', '11' each mapping to a numeric floating-point value in degrees.

title: MP2 optimization and butterfly bending angles for selected compounds
action: Optimize geometries of compounds 5, 6, 10, and 11 at MP2/6-31G(d) level. Compute Ψ as before and report in JSON.
description: Butterfly bending angles (Ψ) in degrees for compounds 5, 6, 10, and 11 at MP2/6-31G(d).
output_schema: A JSON object with keys '5', '6', '10', '11' each mapping to a numeric floating-point value in degrees.

title: Heat of hydrogenation of compound 9
action: Optimize geometries of compound 9, its monohydrogenated product (diene 23), and H2 molecule at B3LYP/6-31G(d). Obtain zero-point corrected total electronic energies. Compute heat of hydrogenation ΔH = E(23) − [E(9) + E(H2)], converted to kcal/mol. Report in JSON.
description: First heat of hydrogenation of compound 9 at B3LYP/6-31G(d).
output_schema: A JSON object with key 'first_hydrogenation_heat' mapping to a numeric floating-point value in kcal/mol.
